events.title: UNHCR calls for emergency aid to address refugee crisis in Niger
events.description: L'UNHCR ha chiesto aiuti urgenti per milioni di rifugiati che fuggono dal Nigeria verso il Niger e il Benin.

events.title: US envoys meet Putin at the Kremlin to discuss Ukraine peace
events.description: Gli inviati statunitensi sono arrivati al Cremlino per colloqui con Vladimir Putin, cercando di rilanciare un accordo di pace per l'Ucraina.

events.title: Fiery clashes erupt across Spain during first general strike in 14 years
events.description: Scaramucce violente sono scoppiate in diverse città spagnole mentre milioni di lavoratori partecipano allo sciopero generale.

events.title: Indonesian VP resigns over education qualification row
events.description: Indonesia’s Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepped down amid controversy over his academic credentials.

events.title: Bessent relocates from home to military base after Iran threats
events.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent moved to a military installation following heightened threats from Iran.

events.title: El Salvador‑backed air assault destroys Haiti gang headquarters amid search for missing troops
events.description: Salvadoran helicopters struck a gang compound in Haiti, destroying the headquarters while searching for four missing Salvadoran personnel.

events.title: UN peacekeepers failed to protect civilians before South Sudan massacre, Amnesty says
events.description: Amnesty International reports that UN forces had prior warning of an attack that killed over 200 people in South Sudan but did not act to prevent it.

events.title: Ukraine peace talks end with prisoner swap but no breakthrough
events.description: Kyiv, Moscow and the United States concluded the Abu Dhabi talks with a limited prisoner exchange, though broader security guarantees remained unresolved.

events.title: German military to stop using Chinese-made drones, citing security concerns
events.description: The German defence ministry announced it will replace Chinese‑origin training drones with European‑made systems for security reasons.

events.title: Lukashenko calls for boosting CSTO military potential
events.description: Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko urged member states of the Collective Security Treaty Organization to enhance their joint military capabilities.

events.title: EBRD plans $6B investment in Türkiye's clean energy projects
events.description: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development announced a five‑year, $6 billion programme to fund renewable‑energy projects across Turkey.

events.title: Russia Says Two Polish Spies Detained in Kaliningrad Region
events.description: The Russian Federal Security Service announced the detention of two Polish citizens accused of espionage in the Kaliningrad enclave.

events.title: Public sector strike suspended as unions agree pay deal
events.description: Irish trade unions called off a planned public‑sector strike after reaching a draft pay agreement with the government.

events.title: Egyptian journalist Lina Attalah faces prison as trial sparks international outcry
events.description: Lina Attalah, head of independent outlet Mada Masr, was brought before a criminal court in Cairo on charges of operating without a licence and publishing false news, prompting condemnation from UN bodies.

events.title: End of U.S.-Iran War Focuses Iraqi Kurds on Middle East’s Challenges, Opportunities at Slemani Strategic Forum
events.description: Leaders gathered in Sulaymaniyah, Iraq, for a strategic forum to discuss regional security and economic cooperation following the de‑escalation of the U.S.–Iran conflict.

events.title: US charges 3 ‘Iranian operatives’ over UK airbase plot
events.description: The U.S. Justice Department indicted three men as “Iranian operatives” for allegedly planning a terrorist attack on Britain’s RAF Fairford airbase.

events.title: Dominican president says he backs Bukele and Salvadoran troops in Haiti
events.description: The Dominican Republic announced logistical and intelligence support for El Salvador’s deployment of roughly 2,500 troops to Haiti amid the island’s security crisis.

events.title: Iraq bars plane carrying Iran's soccer team from landing in Basra over US sanctions, officials say
events.description: Iraq denied entry to an Iranian team’s aircraft bound for Basra, citing U.S. sanctions, heightening tensions between Tehran and Baghdad.

events.title: US soldier arrested in UK on Russian espionage allegations
events.description: A US Army member was detained near Gloucester, England on suspicion of spying for Russia, prompting joint US‑UK investigation.

events.title: Eisenkot vows to undo Netanyahu policies as Israeli parliament opens
events.description: Prime Minister‑designate Gadi Eisenkot pledged to dismantle key policies of the outgoing Netanyahu government during the first session of the new Knesset.

events.title: UK court overturns Trinidad and Tobago law criminalising gay sex
events.description: A London court ruled that Trinidad and Tobago's law banning consensual same‑sex relations was unlawful, marking a significant human‑rights victory.

events.title: Lewis Hamilton visits Egypt’s Rafah crossing and Gaza aid facilities
events.description: The Formula 1 champion toured the Rafah border crossing and logistics warehouses run by the Egyptian Red Crescent, highlighting humanitarian assistance to Gaza.

events.title: Overnight strikes in Yemen kill at least 1 person and wound 9
events.description: Air strikes hit a gas station and an oil facility in Yemen, resulting in one death and nine injuries.

events.title: Financial Security Institute reports data leak following hacking attack — SEOUL
events.description: Le Financial Security Institute de Corée du Sud a confirmé une fuite de données après une cyberattaque ciblant ses systèmes.

events.title: New Israel parliament to be sworn in as Eisenkot works to form new govt
events.description: Le nouveau parlement israélien sera investi à Jérusalem, tandis que le leader Gadi Eisenkot tente de former un gouvernement de coalition.

events.title: Army temporarily grounds Apache helicopters amid U.S. inspection for possible defect
events.description: South Korea suspends operations of its Apache fleet pending a U.S. review, indicating heightened security concerns.

events.title: Ukrainian‑Russian negotiations resume in Abu Dhabi under U.S. mediation
events.description: After nine months, Ukraine and Russia restart direct talks in Abu Dhabi, mediated by the United States.

events.title: Honda pins growth hopes on hybrids with $3 bn US investment
events.description: Honda commits $3 billion to build a new hybrid vehicle plant in the United States, expanding its production capacity.

events.title: U.S. Sanctions Cripple Financial Networks Sustaining the Iranian Regime
events.description: Les États‑Unis ont imposé de nouvelles sanctions financières ciblant les réseaux qui soutiennent le régime iranien.

events.title: Apple announces major Turkey investment with new tech hubs
events.description: Apple will establish several developer academies and a manufacturing academy in Turkey, boosting the local tech sector.

events.title: Tajani annuncia il 13° pacchetto di aiuti militari all'Ucraina: "Non possiamo abbandonare Kiev"
events.description: Il ministro degli Esteri italiano ha firmato il tredicesimo pacchetto di aiuti militari destinati all'Ucraina.

events.title: Niger and Chad’s drone‑strike row exposes deep rifts in the Sahel
events.description: Tensions over a cross‑border drone strike highlight growing rivalry between Niger and Chad, with Moscow and Algerian mediation involved.

events.title: China extends suspension of new rare earth controls until January
events.description: Beijing announced that the temporary suspension of new restrictions on rare‑earth exports will continue for another year.

events.title: China seeks to build ties with Iran
events.description: China's special envoy to the Middle East said Beijing is ready to deepen relations with Tehran.

events.title: Egypt Presses Libya for Sea Border Talks
events.description: Egypt's foreign minister urged Libya in Tripoli to discuss concerns over a Libya‑Turkey sea agreement, but no date was set.

events.title: A supersized El Niño is colliding with a planet already superheated
events.description: The WMO report released at the opening of COP31 in Turkey warns 2026 will be among the hottest years on record.

events.title: Lost savings and broken trust: life for those hit by Ueno Bank’s closure
events.description: Paraguay's central bank took over Ueno Bank, leaving nearly three million Paraguayans unable to access their accounts.

events.title: Hanwha Aerospace to conduct ship‑based Chunmoo missile tests in U.S.
events.description: South Korean firm Hanwha Aerospace announced that its U.S. subsidiary will carry out ship‑based tests of the Chunmoo missile system off the West Coast.

events.title: Philippines seeks bespoke BrahMos missiles from India for island defence
events.description: Manila announced plans to acquire Indian‑made BrahMos cruise missiles, signalling a shift toward diversified defence procurement.

events.title: Pope Leo arrives in Argentina amid divisions over Milei’s austerity
events.description: Pope Leo XIV landed in Buenos Aires, calling for social justice and dialogue as the country grapples with President Milei’s economic reforms.

events.title: New Zealand's new lawmakers start to arrive at parliament as government remains in limbo
events.description: Freshly elected MPs began convening in Wellington’s parliament building while coalition talks continue to determine the next government.

events.title: Attack on Iraq gas complex disrupts supply to region’s power plants, authorities say
events.description: A drone strike hit the Emirati‑owned Khor Mor gas field in Iraq’s Kurdistan region, halting gas deliveries to local power stations.

events.title: Iran Urges Washington To Accept 2-Day Proposal To End Hostilities Or Face 'Hell'
events.description: Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi demanded the United States accept a two‑day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for lifting sanctions, warning of severe consequences.

events.title: Iran’s proposals on opening Strait of Hormuz still on table — top diplomat
events.description: Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran remains ready to negotiate the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz if Washington meets its demands.

events.title: CENTCOM launches task force to disrupt Iranian ground routes
events.description: U.S. Central Command created a new task force to interdict Iranian overland networks used to move advanced weapons and materials.
